newsitem.title: UK: UK's Capital Radio moves into restaurants.
newsitem.headline: UK's Capital Radio moves into restaurants.

text.p: Leading British commercial radio operator Capital Radio on Monday announced it had made a recommended offer for My Kinda Town Plc which valued the themed restaurant group at 51 million pounds ($84 million).

My Kinda Town operates branded restaurants and bars in 16 countries through 54 outlets. The brands include The Chicago Pizza Pie Factory, The Chicago Rib Shack and the Gothic style Beach Blanket Babylon.
Capital, which has pop music stations in London and Birmingham as well as several southern counties, said the acqusition was part of its drive to become a broader media and entertainment group.
Capital said on Monday that its pre-tax profit grew by 21 percent to 32.1 million pounds in the year to September 30. It raised its dividend to 12.5p from 10.3p.
It is offering 190p cash for ordinary shares in My Kinda Town. Shares in the restaurant group rose 20p to 187p on Monday while Capital lost 16p to 577 1/2p. ($1=.6067 Pound)
